Orbit Accounts - How Do Payouts Work? 💸

How Do Payouts Work?

Updated this week

We’ve designed the Orbit Payout System to be fast, flexible, and completely transparent! 🪐

 

Let's break down exactly how you can successfully navigate withdrawals and keep your profit momentum going. 👇

 

💵 Minimums, Maximums, and Freedom

When your account is above its mandatory withdrawal threshold, you can request a payout as long as you are aligned with the 40% consistency rule.

Payout Frequency: You can request a payout every three trading days, starting at a minimum of $500.

The 7-Day Limit: Your total combined withdrawals cannot exceed your specific account size's maximum payout cap within any consecutive 7-day period.

Here are the maximum 7-day payout caps by account size:

50K SFA -> Maximum 7-Day Payout Cap: $2,000
​
​

100K SFA -> Maximum 7-Day Payout Cap: $2,500
​
​

150K SFA -> Maximum 7-Day Payout Cap: $3,000
​
​

200K SFA -> Maximum 7-Day Payout Cap: $2,500
​
​

🔄 Understanding the Rolling 7-Day Window

This is the most important part of the process! Payout caps operate on a rolling 7-day basis from the exact time of your last approved payout request, rather than resetting on a fixed calendar week.

 

Think of your cap as a bucket. Each time a payout is approved, it fills up a piece of that bucket. Exactly 7 days after that specific approval, that amount "rolls off" and opens back up as available cap space!

 

📅 A Real-World Example (50K Account - $2,000 Cap)

Let's look at how this plays out day-by-day:

Tuesday, April 7 -> You request and receive approval for $700.

Remaining available cap: $1,300 (through Monday, April 13).

Thursday, April 9 -> You request and receive approval for $500.

Remaining available cap: $800.

Monday, April 13 -> You request and receive approval for $800.

Remaining available cap: $0. (You have fully utilized your $2,000 limit within this window).

Tuesday, April 14 -> The $700 from your April 7 request officially rolls off! 🥳

Your available cap increases back up to: $700.

Thursday, April 16 -> The $500 from your April 9 request rolls off!

Your available cap increases by: $500.

⚖️ Consistency and Processing

Every time a payout request is successfully processed and approved, your consistency metrics automatically reset for the next window. This ensures you always have a clean slate to structure your trading for your next withdrawal phase—just be sure to review and follow the 40% consistency rule perfectly right before submitting each request! 🛸
